questions.question: What does a solid yellow line on your side of the centerline mean?
questions.explanation: A solid yellow line means you cannot pass other vehicles. If there is a solid yellow line next to a broken yellow line, drivers on the solid yellow side cannot pass. If both lines are solid, no one can pass in either direction.

questions.question: Bridge surfaces can stay icy in winter even after the rest of the road is clear.
questions.explanation: Bridges, overpasses, shaded areas, and curves can stay icy after the rest of the road becomes dry and clear.

questions.question: Illinois law says you must turn on your headlights when you use your windshield wipers.
questions.explanation: Illinois law requires you to have your headlights on whenever you are using your windshield wipers.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Construction or road work is happening.

questions.correctAnswerText: Construction or road work is happening.
questions.explanation: Orange diamond-shaped signs warn drivers about construction, maintenance, and utility work areas. These signs help people drive safely through dangerous zones. Fines for traffic violations can be doubled in these areas.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must go either right or left.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must go either right or left.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. This sign warns drivers that the road splits and they must choose to go either right or left.

questions.question: At a stop sign with no crosswalk, you must stop before entering the intersection.
questions.explanation: At a stop sign, make a complete stop at the stop line if one exists. If there is no stop line, stop before the crosswalk. If there is no crosswalk, stop before entering the intersection.

questions.question: When turning left at an intersection, what should you do?

options.text: Always yield to oncoming traffic and pedestrians.
Oncoming traffic and pedestrians should yield to you.
Never yield to oncoming traffic and pedestrians.

questions.correctAnswerText: Always yield to oncoming traffic and pedestrians.
questions.explanation: When turning left at an intersection, give the right-of-way to oncoming traffic and pedestrians. You may complete the turn only when the intersection is clear and signals allow it.

questions.question: When turning left, you must yield to:
questions.explanation: Drivers turning left must yield to oncoming vehicles going straight. You can only turn left when it is safe and will not affect oncoming traffic.

questions.question: What is the correct way to make a right turn?

options.text: Signal, slow down, and move to the lane closest to the centerline before turning.
Signal, slow down, and move to the lane closest to the right curb before turning.
Approach from the right lane, then move toward the middle of the street before turning.

questions.correctAnswerText: Signal, slow down, and move to the lane closest to the right curb before turning.
questions.explanation: Before turning right, use your turn signal to warn other drivers. Slow down and stay as close as possible to the right curb as you approach the intersection.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. They alert you to what is coming up ahead. This sign warns you that traffic signals are at the next intersection.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Reserved parking for persons with disabilities.

questions.explanation: This sign is posted on one-way streets and roadways where you cannot enter. You may see it if you try to enter an expressway ramp going the wrong way.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you of a steep or long downgrade or hill ahead. The hill may have sharp curves.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A yellow triangle sign with black words means no passing zone. It appears on the left side of two-lane roads where you cannot pass other vehicles.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: An eight-sided red sign means stop.

questions.question: Your driving privileges will be suspended if you are convicted of illegally passing a stopped school bus.
questions.explanation: If you are convicted of passing a stopped school bus with flashing lights and its stop arm out, your driver license will be suspended. If you owned the vehicle but were not driving, you must tell the State's Attorney's Office who was driving. If you don't, your vehicle registration will be suspended for three months.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down and do not use your brakes.

questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road ahead becomes slippery when wet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Watch for people crossing your path.

questions.explanation: This orange sign tells you that construction work is coming up. Stay alert for temporary traffic control devices in the work zone.

questions.question: A driver does not need to allow as much distance when following a motorcycle as when following a car.
questions.explanation: Motorcycles can stop faster than cars in dry conditions. You should stay at least three to four seconds behind a motorcycle so the rider has time to react in an emergency.

questions.question: Temporary signs used in construction and maintenance work areas:

options.text: Have a red background with green writing.
Have an orange background with black writing.
Have a yellow background with blue writing.

questions.correctAnswerText: Have an orange background with black writing.
questions.explanation: All temporary signs in work zones have orange backgrounds with black writing and symbols.

questions.question: "No passing zone" signs tell drivers:

options.text: That it is not safe to pass.

questions.correctAnswerText: That it is not safe to pass.
questions.explanation: A "No passing zone" sign means it is illegal to pass in that area. This is because there is poor visibility and passing would be unsafe.

questions.question: Any amount of alcohol in the blood may affect a driver's:
questions.explanation: Even a small amount of alcohol can harm your ability to drive safely. Alcohol affects how well you can judge situations and control your body. Even low levels of alcohol can lead to criminal charges.

questions.question: Which of these statements is true about large trucks?

options.text: They take longer to stop than passenger vehicles.
They all have air brakes that allow them to stop quickly.
They are more maneuverable than passenger vehicles.

questions.correctAnswerText: They take longer to stop than passenger vehicles.
questions.explanation: Large trucks need more distance to stop than cars. A car going 55 mph can stop in about 400 feet. A large truck going the same speed needs almost 800 feet to stop.

questions.question: Before you change lanes, you should check your mirrors and:

options.text: Never look over your right shoulder.
Always slow down in your traffic lane.

questions.explanation: Before changing lanes, look over your shoulder to check for vehicles in the lane you want to enter. This helps you see cars that might not appear in your mirrors. Make sure no other drivers are moving into the same spot.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Diamond-shaped signs warn drivers about hazards ahead. Orange color is used for construction and maintenance warnings.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a yield sign is coming. Slow down when you see this sign.

questions.question: Motorists are not required to yield to pedestrians if they are walking against the traffic light.
questions.explanation: You must always yield to pedestrians. Be aware that pedestrians may cross against the light by mistake.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Pedestrians walking along the road ahead.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign tells you that pedestrians may cross ahead. Stop and wait for pedestrians to finish crossing before you drive.

questions.question: The best thing to do if you become tired while driving is to:

options.text: Stop to rest or change drivers.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop to rest or change drivers.
questions.explanation: If you are tired while driving, stop to rest or let someone else drive. Tiredness makes it harder to think and react, which is dangerous.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign shows a crosswalk location. Watch carefully and let pedestrians cross safely.

questions.question: It is necessary to use your low beams any time you are:
questions.explanation: Use low beams when driving in fog, snow, rain, or mist. High beams reflect off wet weather and create glare. Some vehicles have fog lights that work with low beams.
